title: Prompt suggestions send an extra request after each response
source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/costs (a short request after each response, mostly cache reads plus a few output tokens); setting promptSuggestionEnabled: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference

fix.text: Set promptSuggestionEnabled to false (the Prompt suggestions toggle in /config). Each suggestion re-reads your whole cached context.
